dialogues.speaker: Admonisher's Records
dialogues.text: (Barely legible words have been inscribed here...)

dialogues.speaker: Admonisher's Records
dialogues.text: "Leave now, hurry... This place is already... Must beware... of deceptive... bewitchment..."

dialogues.speaker: Admonisher's Records
dialogues.text: "Remember, do not look! Do not look! Do not look!"

dialogues.speaker: Admonisher's Records
dialogues.text: (Below are some chaotic carvings. They illustrate the unsound mind of the engraver...)
